blocks.arabic_text: قَبِلَتِ الْمَاءَ فَأَنْبَتَتِ الْكَلأَ وَالْعُشْبَ الْكَثِيرَ وَكَانَتْ مِنْهَا أَجَادِبُ أَمْسَكَتِ الْمَاءَ فَنَفَعَ اللهُ بِهَا النَّاسَ فَشَرِبُوا وَسَقَوْا وَزَرَعُوا وَأَصَابَ مِنْهَا طَائِفَةً أُخْرَي إِنَّمَا هِيَ قِيعَانٌ لَا تُمْسِكُ مَاءً وَلَا تُنْبِتُ كَلأً فَذلِكَ مَثَلُ مَنْ فَقُهَ فِي دِينِ اللهِ وَنَفَعَهُ مَا بَعَثَنِيَ اللهُ بِهِ فَعَلِمَ وَعَلَّمَ وَمَثَلُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرْفَعْ بِذلِكَ رَأْساً وَلَمْ يَقْبَلْ هُدَي اللهِ الَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب فضل من علم وعلم رقم:٧٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The example of the knowledge, wisdom and guidance with which Allah has sent me is like abundant rain that fell; the land that received the rain is of three kinds. The first kind: the land on which the rain fell was of excellent fertility; it absorbed the water and caused abundant grass and plants to grow. The second kind: it was hard; it did not soak the water into itself, but it held the water upon itself, and Allah made it too a benefit for people; they drank the water themselves, gave it to their animals to drink, and also watered their fields. The third kind: a barren plain that neither holds water nor grows grass and plants. (In the same way, people too are of three kinds.) The first kind of person: one who gained understanding of the Deen; Allah benefited him with the guidance (Hidayah) with which He sent me; he himself learnt and also taught others. The second kind of person: he did not benefit, but others benefited through him. The third kind of person: he did not even raise his head to look at the Ilm that I brought, nor did he accept the guidance with which Allah sent me.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال:هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في تعليم القران رقم:٢٩٠٧
